title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1971-12-10
lineage: MR> DAT> Latvala's Cassette> D> CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy December ’71 show featuring a smoking Other One → Sitting on Top of the World sandwich, an epic Good Lovin’, and a stellar Brokedown Palace.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers a clear, piano‑rich soundboard mix that lets the band’s December ’71 firepower shine. The second set is the centerpiece – a seamless Too > Sittin' on Top of the World > Too sequence, an 18‑minute Good Lovin’, and a gorgeous Brokedown Palace – while the first set holds solid classics like Comes A Time and Truckin’. Overall the performance feels vibrant, tight, and full of the fresh enthusiasm of Keith’s early days with Pigpen back on vocals.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (majority 5‑star) highlight high energy, standout songs and a clean soundboard source; only minor complaints about occasional hiss or speed issues keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear piano/keys, crisp overall mix; a few listeners note slight hiss and occasional speed/tuning quirks but these are minor and do not detract from the listening experience.

standout_songs: The Other One > Sitting on Top of the World > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid but less remarkable; second set launches into a high‑energy, tightly sequenced marathon that defines the show’s momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for turning listeners onto new songs and delivering strong guitar work throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned as providing perfect bass support; “Phil bombs” vibe noted by several reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for emerging vocal presence, backing Pigpen on NFA and overall stronger performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s early piano/organ sound is repeatedly praised as sweet, jazzy, and a key addition to the band’s texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann cited for perfect support; rhythm section described as tight and powerful.
